title: Rabies shots after a bite
also: rabies shots after a dog bite
rabies shot after a cat bite
what: A course of shots after an animal bite or scratch. It stops rabies from developing, if started in time.
why: After a bite, scratch, or saliva on broken skin from a dog, cat, wild animal, or bat.
duration: each shot takes a few seconds; the course is several shots on a schedule over a few weeks
tell_doctor: What animal it was: a pet or a stray
When and where you were bitten
If the animal can be watched
If you had rabies vaccines before
If you are pregnant or have immune system conditions

prepare.title: Right after the bite
prepare.text: Wash the wound under running water with soap for at least 15 minutes.

prepare.title: Do not wait
prepare.text: Go to an urgent care clinic right away. The sooner the shots start, the better.

prepare.title: The animal
prepare.text: If you can, ask the owner if the animal is vaccinated. It needs to be watched for 10 days.

bring: Details about the animal and its owner, if known
steps: The doctor examines and cleans the wound
They ask about the animal and decide if a course is needed
The first shot is given in the upper arm
For deep bites, another medicine is sometimes injected around the wound
You get a schedule for the next shots
The doctor decides if a tetanus shot is needed
feel: Sometimes soreness at the spot, tiredness, or a mild fever
after: Do not miss any shots on the schedule. This is very important
Your doctor may ask you not to drink alcohol during the course
If the animal is healthy after 10 days, the doctor may end the course early
red_flags: Trouble breathing, swelling of the face or throat, or a rash all over: call emergency services
The wound becomes very red, swollen, or full of pus, or you get a fever

faq.a: Usually several shots in the upper arm, on a schedule. Your doctor will say exactly how many.

faq.q: Can I skip the shots if it was a pet dog?
faq.a: The doctor decides. Often a vaccinated animal is watched for 10 days, and the course starts before that.

faq.q: What if I missed a shot?
faq.a: Contact your doctor right away. They will tell you how to continue.

reminders.text: Your next rabies shot is tomorrow, on schedule. Do not miss it.
